entities.summary: Cheng Dawei, also known as Da Wei Cheng or Ch'eng Ta-wei, was a Chinese mathematician and writer who was known mainly as the author of Suanfa Tongzong (算法統宗). He has been described as "the most illustrious Chinese arithmetician."
